title: Saturday’s recruiting call
lede: September 1 was not the finish line. Some of you got the calls you wanted. Some of you didn’t. Either way — this 2028 cycle is slow, coaches are still deciding 2027s, and the work is the same: a bigger list, real relationships, and making it easy to recruit you.

landscape.title: Patience is the instruction
landscape.body: P4 programs are still taking 2027s. One Power conference school sent a letter pausing all 2028 recruiting — five-for-five plus litigation, resources still on seniors. The kids committing this week are not the whole class. Finding the fit beats matching someone else’s timeline.

landscape.title: Coaches are insecure too
landscape.body: They will not spend time on a kid until they believe she actually wants them. If you would leave your region, say why. If you camped three other places, tell this one she is still on your list. Do not leave “would she come here?” implied.

landscape.title: You are in sales
landscape.body: Ten nos before a yes. A no is compatibility, not a verdict on your talent. You would not be on this roster if you could not play the next level.

doThis: Rebuild your list to about 40 schools. Tag them reach, realistic, and safety. Spread it across divisions.
Fill out the questionnaire at every school on that list. That puts you on their radar.
Follow the program and every coach. Once they follow back, DM. DMs are beating email right now.
Lead every message with your best verified number — exit velo, overhand, pop, home-to-first. Pin it. Do not make them dig.
Keep a short, easy-to-eval video. Swings in a row, a couple plays, pitchers a couple of each pitch. Repin it when something good happens.
Post a thank-you to the coaches who have followed you. FOMO is real. Other staffs notice.
Put Mike and Joe on the same message. No duplicate relay.
camps: School-hosted camps at schools you are targeting. Skip money-making camps.
Talk to the coach before you go, the day of, and after. Ask how they want you to stay in touch. Email them before you tweet.
Elon Saturday is on because they like how this team plays. That interest is a door, not a lock — use it.
staff: Mike will take a one-on-one with every player who asks. Four are already done. Reach out. He will not force a school.
Internal team camp is a good problem — visits and direct-invite camps have seven definite. We need ten or eleven, or we bolt skills onto a tournament weekend. Be patient while we lock the date.
2029s: start now. Learn from the 2028s. It is never too early.
